draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.26, the 66th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 12th of 32 at WR. He lasted until pick 195, well after his grade rank (66th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: DeVante Parker. Testing standouts: broad jump (90th percentile). Testing concerns: 10-yard split (7th percentile). College production: 1,096 receiving yards in 2022, 6th of 32 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: inactive. Last NFL action came in 2023. 10 career games and 3 starts over 1 completed season. Career-best season: 2 AV in 2023. Weak spots: team target share 3.1% (23rd percentile). Played 10 of 17 games in 2023.
